description: Ministry of Labour - Notice of Repudiation of Award of an Arbitrator (E Only)
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the repudiation of an arbitrator's award under the Industrial Disputes Act (Chapter 131). It involves legal procedures, statutory notices, and regulatory compliance requirements related to industrial disputes, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories like land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
